subject: Discovery + POC Plan: validation sprint and access matrix
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@clearline.ai>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@clearline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery + POC Plan: validation sprint and access matrix

Hi Oliver / Sara — thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re all aligned before the kickoff: 
Summary of pain and goals
- Pain: noisy intent classification and long human review cycle (~48-72h) across triage flows.
- Goal: reduce review volume by 40% on high-confidence prompts and cut average review time to <24h while preserving precision >= 95% on critical labels.

Proposed POC scope (30 days)
- Validation sprint (2 weeks): run our prompt/eval suite against a 10k sample of historical transcripts you shared.
- Integration and live shadowing (2 weeks): run in parallel to production, capture false-positive/false-negative cases and operator feedback.
- Success metrics: review volume reduction, precision @ threshold, latency tail (p95) for inference.

Access / data asks
- A sanitized sample CSV with message_id, text, label, metadata (we referenced schema during the call). If possible, please share within 3 business days.
- Account dev/ops contact for IP allowlist and temporary service account creation.

Owners & timeline
- Clearline: provide sample dataset + dev contact by 2026-12-24 (Oliver).
- Redwood: deliver POC matrix + prompt/eval pack by 2026-12-23 (Marissa).
- Kickoff call to schedule once dataset is available — propose Wed 12/29 or Thu 12/30 for a short 30-minute kickoff.

Attachments: I’ve attached the POC-matrix template we’ll use (POC-matrix-v1.xlsx) and a short mutual action plan.

Open questions for you
1) Will the dataset include metadata for channel (email/portal/chat)?
2) Any constraints on sharing a production-like sample (PII redaction needs)?
3) Do you have a preferred SLA window for the shadow runs (business hours only or 24/7)?

If that all looks right I’ll follow up with the official mutual action plan and loop in Ben (our infra lead) to scope the temporary sandbox.

Thanks — talk soon,

Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Thanks Hannah — this is great, appreciate the clear summary. Confirming a few items from our side: 

- We can get you a 10k row sample extracted and pseudonymized by end of day 12/23. It will include channel and timestamp metadata. I’ll attach a small example export (CL_prod_sample_schema.csv) to this thread.
- Priority success metric for us is reducing manual workload (headcount time) and improving mean time to triage — precision is important but we can accept a slight recall tradeoff if review time drops.
- For the sandbox, network/admin details: we prefer IP allowlist and short-lived service accounts; SOC2 documents would also help our security team. Can you point me to the SOC2 scope and your private deployment options?

We’re happy to kick off the week of 12/28. Wed 12/29 at 10am PT works for our engineering lead Sara; if that’s OK for you we can lock the time.

Thanks,
Oliver
VP Product
Clearline Solutions
oliver.grant@clearline.ai | +1 650-555-2270

- Marissa Cole (CS/solutions): owner for prompt pack and eval set construction. Deliver POC prompt suite + evaluation rubrics by 2026-12-23.
- Ben Carter (Infra): provision temporary sandbox (Redwood Dedicated dev pool) with IP allowlist and service account by 2026-12-28. Confirm SOC2 access path to Clearline’s security team.

External asks to track

Operational notes
- We will use continuous batching and prefix caching during shadow runs to keep p95 latency under 300ms; Ben to validate GPU profile needed for the 10k sample run.
- Marissa to seed the eval set with high-priority intents first (billing, account changes, fraud).

Attachments: I’ve uploaded POC-matrix-v1.xlsx to the shared Drive link and drafted the mutual-action-plan.docx — please review and comment inline by EOD 12/23. HubSpot deal CL-4521 has been updated with milestones: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CL-4521

Ben — can you confirm whether we should reserve a 1x A10x instance for the sprint or if a smaller burst instance will suffice? If you can reply before 12/23 we’ll have the sandbox up by 12/28.
